title: Rejection transition
statement: For every Boolean finite machine $B$, states $q_v,q_i$ of $B$, Boolean flag $stop$, and Boolean words $x,s$, one step of the body machine with parameters $B,q_v,q_i,stop$, from the configuration on input $x$ in control state $3$ whose first and last work tapes store $s$ and the one-bit word $[\mathrm{false}]$, respectively, and whose endpoint heads are at zero, yields the configuration in control state $(q_i,2)$ with the first tape still storing $s$, the last tape blank, both endpoint heads at zero, and all other fields unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
replaced:
For every candidate word $s$, one step of the enumerator body (active or stopped)
from the two-ended configuration in the verdict state with tape zero $s$ and a
captured single false bit yields the two-ended configuration that enters the
increment call (the source's increment entry state in increment mode), with tape
zero $s$, the captured verdict erased so that the capture tape is blank, and both
endpoint heads at zero.
